description: Estimate annual WFLR FTSO-delegation rewards for delegating an amount to a Flare FTSO provider (defaults to FlareWatch). Annualizes the provider's latest realized per-epoch reward rate (rate x ~104.29 epochs/yr). Returns estimated APR and annual/monthly reward in FLR. A projection, not a guarantee; FTSO delegation only, not P-chain staking. found=false when the provider isn't cached.
name: simulate_delegation_rewards
title: Simulate Delegation Rewards
